python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f20 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0020.png').convert('RGB'))

# Chair in F20:
chair = (f20[:, 200:, 0] > 80) & (f20[:, 200:, 0] < 160) & (f20[:, 200:, 1] > 35) & (f20[:, 200:, 1] < 80) & (f20[:, 200:, 2] < 40)
y_c, x_c = np.where(chair)
x_c += 200
print('Chair in F20: x in', x_c.min(), x_c.max(), 'y in', y_c.min(), y_c.max())

f = 256.0
cx = 255.5
cy = 255.5
h = 1.55

# In F20: pos is (1.0, 1.5), heading is 90 deg (+x).
# Chair bottom y:
y_bot = y_c.max()
x_mid = (x_c.min() + x_c.max()) / 2.0
z_ch = f * h / (y_bot - cy)
x_ch = (x_mid - cx) * z_ch / f
print(f'F20 Chair: z={z_ch:.3f}, x={x_ch:.3f} -> World: X={1.0 + z_ch:.3f}, Y={1.5 - x_ch:.3f}')
"
